en.joke: My deepest fear is dying alone in my apartment, and the delivery driver who finds me just sighs about the missed tip.
en.explanation: This joke uses dark humor to highlight the transactional nature of modern life, contrasting a serious event with the trivial concern of a delivery tip.

zh.joke: 我发现人生的本质就是不断地进行'数据清洗'：把没用的社交关系删掉，把没用的APP卸载掉，把购物车里没用的东西清空。可惜，体重这个数据总是洗不干净。

people.name: Alfred Lépine
people.extract: Joseph Alfred Pierre Hormisdas "Pit" Lépine was a Canadian ice hockey forward and coach. He was born in Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue, Quebec.

people.name: Hirving Lozano
people.extract: Hirving Rodrigo Lozano Bahena, also known by his nickname Chucky, is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and the Mexico national team.
highlights: Plays as a winger for San Diego FC.
Member of the Mexico national team.

people.name: Ron Block
people.extract: Ronald Franklin Block is an American banjo player, guitarist, and singer-songwriter, best known as a member of the bluegrass band Alison Krauss & Union Station. He has won 14 Grammy Awards, 6 International Bluegrass Music Awards, a Country Music Association Award, and a Gospel Music Association Dove Award.
highlights: Member of Alison Krauss & Union Station.
Also won 6 International Bluegrass Music Awards.
